_comment: Single source of truth for the font-fidelity harness. Consumed by tools/capture_font_reference.py (renders each sample in Chromium with the real Roboto TTF) and by FontFidelityTest (renders the same sample through Awake's atlas pipeline and compares). Add a row here rather than editing either side. 'id' names the PNG; 'text' is rendered verbatim; 'sizePx' is the font size in CSS pixels, matched by the Kotlin side's glyph size.

samples.why: The string whose 'a' was reported as sitting a pixel low. Mixes cap-height (E), x-height flat (m, i, l) and x-height round (a).
Reported second. Dense in round glyphs (a c e s) plus parens and quotes, so overshoot and descender groups both appear.
Isolates the question directly: flat-bottomed i/l against round a/e/c/o at the same size.
Same string at 14px, where our own snapping arithmetic behaves differently from 12px.
Same string at 16px, a common real UI size.
Conventional typographer's test string: ascenders, descenders, round and flat bottoms, and digits.
